---
title: "Management Committee"
---

The Management Committee is responsible for providing strategic direction and ensuring effective administration of the Association in accordance with the registered Bye-laws.

The Committee oversees technical programmes, membership development, finance, publications, collaborations, and long-term institutional growth while maintaining transparency, accountability, and ethical governance.
